prompt:
Write a client review left on a freelance platform for Mina Castellan after this project.

Project facts (the only truth you may use):
title: Snowflake cost audit
client: confidential
client_industry: fintech
start: 2024-01
end: 2024-02
engagement: fixed
stack:
- Snowflake
- SQL
implied_skills:
- query optimization
built: Found the most expensive scheduled queries and warehouses and rewrote or resized
  them.
metrics:
- monthly credits down 34%

The review is from: a client in fintech (name withheld)
Rating: 4.5 out of 5

Requirements:
- 2 to 5 sentences in the voice of a busy client, not a marketer.
- Focus mostly on how they handled feedback; do not just repeat the project summary.
- If the rating is below 4.5, include one honest complaint (communication, delays or scope).
- Only mention results that appear in the facts. Never use: "query optimization".
text: Mina was easy to work with on our Snowflake cost audit and took feedback well throughout the engagement. When we asked for changes, she adjusted quickly and stayed focused on what would make the biggest impact. She found the most expensive scheduled queries and warehouses and rewrote or resized them, which brought our monthly credits down 34%. Would work with her again.
